name: engineering-team
description: Multi-harness repo-first engineering plugin for Codex and other coding agents: map the repo, route specialists, gate risky decisions, verify changes, and preserve reusable context.

interface.shortDescription: Repo-first engineering workflow for coding agents.
interface.longDescription: Maps repositories before edits, routes the smallest useful specialist team, traces contracts, gates risky decisions with a read-only advisor, requires evidence, verifies changes, and preserves reusable repo knowledge without bloating context.
defaultPrompt: Use EngineeringTeam to investigate this bug. Map the repo first, trace the contract graph, then propose the smallest safe fix.
Use EngineeringTeam to review this branch. Route to architecture, security, performance, verification, and evidence skepticism only where relevant.
Use EngineeringTeam to implement this feature. Build a repo atlas, component brief, evidence ledger, and verification report before final handoff.
Use EngineeringTeam advisor gate before a production-sensitive or conflicting-evidence decision.
